hooks.command: today=$(date +%Y%m%d); [ "$(cat "$HOME/.claude/.concise-update-stamp" 2>/dev/null)" = "$today" ] && exit 0; command -v claude >/dev/null 2>&1 && claude plugin marketplace update claude-skill-concise >/dev/null 2>&1 && claude plugin update concise@claude-skill-concise >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf '%s' "$today" > "$HOME/.claude/.concise-update-stamp" || true

[ -f "$HOME/.claude/.concise-welcomed" ] || { printf 'concise installed: /concise:rewrite (retrofit a text), /concise:pr (PR description from the diff), /concise:card (task that stands alone), /concise:commit (message for the staged diff), plus the audit agent. This note shows once.\n'; touch "$HOME/.claude/.concise-welcomed"; }

in=$(cat); if printf '%s' "$in" | grep -qE 'git commit|gh pr create' && printf '%s' "$in" | grep -qiE 'co-authored-by:.{0,60}claude|generated with.{0,60}claude'; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"AI credit found in the text (Co-Authored-By / Generated with). The concise rule bans crediting an AI agent in commits and PRs - rewrite without it."}}'; fi
